english.title: Fail to disclose change of circumstances material to application for entitlement to accommodation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having made an application under Chapter 2 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014, failed to notify the local housing authority as soon as possible of a change of facts material to the case that had occurred prior to receiving notification of the local housing authority's decision on the application, the authority having explained to you in ordinary language the duty imposed on you to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97(4) and (6) of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
